The optimizer characteristic polynomial factors as two rational cubic factors, with the smallest root exactly isolated in (0.076,0.077); all eight optimal deleted triples are directed triangles. value.rationale: Nine independent observations are the natural minimum for exact recovery of the nine-dimensional quadratic harmonic band on the sphere. There are 220 ways to choose the nine observations from this symmetric twelve-point polyhedron. All 128 reconstructing choices have exactly the same Gram determinant, so D-optimality supplies no distinction. The sharp eight-mask E-optimal classification therefore answers a motivated conditioning question with a nontrivial strict spectral gap and interpretable directed-triangle geometry; it is not a routine rank census or arbitrary small parameter calculation.
